Physician Consultation Summary
Date: 2024-04-05
Reason for Visit: Chronic sleep disruption, profound fatigue, and appetite loss

Patient narrative:
"I haven't been able to sleep properly for weeks now. I wake up at 3am drenched in sweat and my mind just spins. Food has completely lost its appeal; I've lost nearly 4 kg over the past month. Even getting dressed in the morning feels like climbing a steep mountain. The tiredness is completely overwhelming, but when I try to rest, I am restless and agitated."

Assessment:
Somatic signs of mood disturbance prominent. Marked sleep maintenance insomnia, early morning awakening, and appetite suppression.
